title: This $150 lifetime AI-powered app listens while you play piano and coaches you in real time
content_html:
TL;DR: Get Skoove Premium lifetime access for $149.99 (reg. $299.99) and learn piano with an AI-powered app that provides real-time feedback and includes 400+ interactive lessons plus ongoing updates.

Credit: Skoove

$149.99
$299.99 Save $150

Looking for a new hobby to unwind after a long day of work? Skoove Premium Piano Lessons brings the learning to your home, helping you master the piano or keyboard with an app on your smartphone, tablet, or laptop. And right now, you can lock in a lifetime of lessons for only $149.99 (reg. $299.99).

When was the last time you learned a new skill? If mastering the piano has always been on your bucket list, it’s time to make it happen with this lifetime subscription to Skoove Premium Piano Lessons. This AI-powered app lets you pick up piano in your spare time without ever leaving your house.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

All you need to get started with Skoove Premium Piano Lessons is a keyboard or piano and your laptop, smartphone, or tablet. The app does the rest, as it can hear you play, recognize your notes, and give you real-time feedback so you get better as you go.

Mashable Trend Report

Whether you’re totally new to the instrument or you have some lessons under your belt, Skoove offers lesson options ranging from beginner to advanced. And it’s not like the boring old piano lessons from your past; you’ll get to pick up skills by playing your favorite music — from Adele to Beethoven.

Your lifetime subscription includes permanent access to more than 400 lessons and thousands of instructional videos, and you’ll never run out of content because new ones are added every month. There’s also one-on-one support available from real music instructors when you need it.

Get this lifetime subscription to Skoove Premium Piano Lessons for just $149.99 (reg. $299.99).

StackSocial prices subject to change.

$149.99

在一整天的工作后寻找新的爱好来放松？ Skoove 高级钢琴课程将学习带到您的家中，帮助您通过智能手机、平板电脑或笔记本电脑上的应用程序掌握钢琴或键盘。 现在，您只需 149.99 美元（原价 299.99 美元）即可锁定终生课程。

您最后一次学习新技能是什么时候？ 如果掌握钢琴一直在您的愿望清单上，那么是时候通过终身订阅 Skoove 高级钢琴课程来实现这一目标了。 这款人工智能应用程序让您足不出户即可在闲暇时间拿起钢琴。

混搭优惠

注册即表示您同意按照提供的号码接收来自 Mashable Deals 的定期自动 SMS 营销消息。 消息和数据速率可能适用。 每天最多 2 条消息。 回复 STOP 可选择退出，回复 HELP 寻求帮助。 同意不是购买的条件。 请参阅我们的隐私政策和使用条款。

开始使用 Skoove Premium Piano Lessons 所需的只是键盘或钢琴以及笔记本电脑、智能手机或平板电脑。 该应用程序会完成剩下的工作，因为它可以听到您的演奏，识别您的音符，并为您提供实时反馈，以便您在演奏时变得更好。

可混搭趋势报告

无论您是乐器新手还是已经掌握了一些课程，Skoove 都提供从初级到高级的课程选择。 这不像你过去那些无聊的旧钢琴课；它不像你以前的钢琴课。您将通过演奏您最喜欢的音乐（从阿黛尔到贝多芬）来学习技能。

您的终身订阅包括永久访问 400 多节课程和数千个教学视频，而且您永远不会用完内容，因为每个月都会添加新内容。 当您需要时，真正的音乐教练还可以提供一对一的支持。

只需 149.99 美元（原价 299.99 美元）即可获得 Skoove 高级钢琴课程的终身订阅。
